thesis: Josh Brown argues that he spent approximately ten years realizing his previous practices in the advisory and investing spaces were wrong, counterproductive for clients, and damaging to his own psyche. He states that once he realized these practices made no sense, he chose to come out publicly about the truth rather than keeping it to himself.
